openipmi.service.name: Hardware sensor driver (IPMI)
openipmi.service.note: It reads physical hardware sensors, which a virtual machine usually does not have.

motd-news.service.name: Login news banner
motd-news.service.note: It is cosmetic: only the message shown at SSH login.

L1.what: {desc_raw} ({unit}) points at a program that no longer exists, so it fails every time it starts.{notesp}
L1.why: The program was removed or replaced (often by a packaged version under another name), but the old service was left behind.

L1.what: {desc_raw} ({unit}) stopped and has not come back.{notesp}
L1.why: It crashed or failed to start, and nothing restarts it automatically.

variants.how: Ask me to restart it, or run: {ctl} restart {unit}
